markdown:
##### Source: Dungeon Master's Guide (Staff of the Woodlands)

*Peripheral, rare (requires installation by a [shut-in](/shutin))*

**Specs:** 4 lbs., $$5,000,000

This heavy-duty gardening rake can be wielded as a technical [quarterstaff](/weapon:quarterstaff) that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to tech attack rolls.

The rake has 10 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the rake loses its properties and becomes a non-technical quarterstaff (though you can still use it for gardening purposes, silver lining).

**Techs.** You can use an action to expend 1 or more of the rake's charges to cast one of the following techs from it, using your tech save DC: [Pack Leader](/tech:pack-leader) (1 charge), [Singularity](/tech:singularity) (5 charges), [Ceramiron Skin](/tech:ceramiron-skin) (2 charges), [Organic Sensor](/tech:organic-sensor) (2 charges), [Doolittle's Dialog](/tech:doolittles-dialog) (1 charge), [Isley's Dialog](/tech:isleys-dialog) (3 charges), or [Arcbarricade](/tech:arcbarricade) (6 charges).

You can also use an action to cast the [Nanofog](/tech:nanofog) tech from the rake without using any charges.

**Tree Form.** You can use an action to plant one end of the rake in fertile earth and expend 1 charge to transform the rake into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius. The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of [Manipulation](/glossary-of-terms) tech if targeted by [Anomaly Detector](/tech:anomaly-detector). While touching the tree and using another action to speak its command, word, you return the rake to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when it reverts to a rake.
